description: Fixtures for src/lib/azure/output.test.ts: raw output streams of real az runs against the LocalStack Azure emulator.
Each stream is a byte copy, stored base64 (gzip+base64 above 4 KB) so that no line-ending conversion (core.autocrlf) can touch its CRLFs.
sha256 and bytes are those of the decoded bytes; the test checks both.
Synthetic entries (synthetic: true) say in 'basis' what they were reconstructed from; they exist only where no raw stream was kept.
classId is the class classifyFailure gives with the guard state guardOn (null for a success); egress, when present, is the guard record the run would have had.

fixtures.basis: Not reproduced: nothing safe triggers a 500. The message is the emulator's gateway.py text; the shape copies the native ARM error of not-implemented-native.
Reconstructed from a run of group delete without --yes, with stdin ended at spawn: the two lines are quoted verbatim; the raw stream was not kept, so the CRLFs are assumed.
Reconstructed from a run on the SDK data-plane path (86.5 s without fail-fast): the stderr line is quoted verbatim and names no host; the host comes from the guard's record.
Reconstructed from a run of az rest to an absolute management.azure.com URL: the first and last lines are quoted verbatim; the traceback frames between them were not kept and are left out.
Reconstructed from a run of group list with HTTPS_PROXY pointing at a stopped guard (exit 1 after 14 s): the line is quoted verbatim; the raw stream was not kept.
The update-check warning is quoted verbatim from a recorded run; the stdout is a byte copy of ok-group-list's. They were never printed together.
